# CalcGlobal

> Free, accurate tax and financial calculators for US, UK, France, Germany, and Australia. Verified against 2026 official authority rates (IRS, HMRC, URSSAF, Finanzamt, ATO).

## About
CalcGlobal provides professional-grade tax calculators for 5 countries. Every formula is sourced directly from official government tax authority documents and updated annually.

## Available Calculators

### United States (/us)
- 1099 Self-Employment & Quarterly Estimated Tax Calculator (/us/us-1099-self-employment-tax-calculator)
- S-Corp Election vs LLC Tax Savings Calculator (/us/s-corp-vs-llc-tax-savings-calculator)
- W-2 Gross-to-Net Paycheck Tax & Take-Home Calculator (/us/w2-salary-paycheck-take-home-calculator)
- Home Sale Net Proceeds & Section 121 Capital Gains Tax Calculator (/us/us-home-sale-net-proceeds-capital-gains-calculator)
- Small Business Commercial Lease & Break-Even Revenue Calculator (/us/us-small-business-lease-break-even-calculator)

### United Kingdom (/uk)
- UK IR35 Status & Take-Home Pay Calculator (Inside vs Outside IR35) (/uk/ir35-inside-outside-calculator)

- UK Take-Home Salary & Tax Calculator (Income Tax, NI & Pension) (/uk/uk-gross-net-salary-pension-calculator)
- UK Limited Company Director Salary vs Dividend Tax Optimizer (/uk/uk-limited-company-director-salary-dividend-calculator)
- UK Statutory Redundancy Pay & Settlement Agreement Tax Calculator (/uk/uk-statutory-redundancy-settlement-calculator)

### France (/fr)

### Germany (/de)

- HMRC (His Majesty's Revenue and Customs) — gov.uk/hmrc

- Bundesfinanzministerium (BMF) — bundesfinanzministerium.de  
- Australian Taxation Office (ATO) — ato.gov.au
